name: Fel Infusion raises critical strike chance by 3 points (#3738)
contract: Fel Infusion 560533 effect 0 (SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AREA_AURA_RAID, SPELL_AURA_MOD_CRIT_PCT/aura 290, TARGET_UNIT_CASTER) carries EffectBasePoints 2 with DieSides 1, so SpellEffectInfo::CalcValue resolves the aura's own GetAmount() to 3 (basePoints+1) -- the only number this scenario derives and asserts. Effect 1 (custom SPELL_AURA_ASCENSION_MOD_CRIT_CHANCE, aura 350, misc 127 = all seven school bits, also resolving to 3) is HandleNoImmediateEffect; its only two consumers, grepped across the whole tree, are Unit::GetUnitCriticalChance (Unit.cpp:4126) and Unit::SpellDoneCritChance (Unit.cpp:9612) -- both crit-roll time only, never a PLAYER_CRIT_PERCENTAGE/PLAYER_SPELL_CRIT_PERCENTAGE1+school stat field, so effect 1 is real but has nothing this harness can read. This scenario used to assert effect 0's contribution indirectly, as a before/after delta on melee_crit_chance and spell_crit_chance (PLAYER_CRIT_PERCENTAGE / PLAYER_SPELL_CRIT_PERCENTAGE1+school), snapshotting the same single actor before and after learning 560533. That still measured a 4.973 delta against the derived 3-point expectation on a genuinely self-relative comparison (confirmed: the harness run that produced 4.973 was of this file's own corrected, single-actor, relative_to version, not an earlier two-actor draft). Player::UpdateCritPercentage (StatSystem.cpp:762-799, invoked via HandleAuraModCritPct -> UpdateAllWeaponDependentCritAuras -> SetBaseModFlatValue -> UpdateBaseModGroup every time this aura type is (re)applied) does not add only the aura's own flat contribution: it recomputes the whole field from GetBaseModValue(FLAT_MOD) + GetBaseModValue(PCT_MOD) + GetRatingBonusValue(CR_CRIT_MELEE) + a weapon-skill-vs-cap term in the same pass, and Player::UpdateSpellCritChance (StatSystem.cpp:948-968) similarly recomputes GetSpellCritFromIntellect() + aura sum + GetRatingBonusValue(CR_CRIT_SPELL) together. Source review traced every one of Fel Infusion's own effects and confirmed none of them touch agility, combat rating, or weapon skill (no module coefficient exists for 560533 at all -- grepped, zero hits in modules/mod-ascension-compat), so the extra ~1.97 could not be attributed to a specific line without executing the scenario to inspect the intermediate rating/PCT_MOD/weapon-skill terms directly, which is out of scope here (no scenario runs). Because these two Update* functions rewrite the stat field from several inputs at once rather than adding a pure delta, a before/after read of them cannot reliably isolate one aura's contribution -- the same reasoning already applied to #3500 and #1017 in this batch. This version instead asserts effect 0's own resolved value directly via aura_amount, which reads AuraEffect::GetAmount() with no other term mixed in.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Fel Infusion's crit-chance effect resolves to 3 (EffectBasePoints 2 + 1, DieSides 1)
